summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 new features: (1) Product Hunt homepage ribbon, (2) Admin Analytics 'Launch offer' KPI section, (3) Project workspace change-notification banner. All three features work end-to-end with the correct data-testids and expected behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing dev-only React hydration warning at AdminAnalytics.jsx:410 — a <span> is being rendered as a child of <option> (caused by visual-editor injection wrappers). Not from the new PH code, but appears whenever the AdminAnalytics page renders. Consider suppressing/adjusting if it becomes noisy in production build.
AdminAnalytics charts emit 'width(-1) height(-1)' Recharts warnings on initial render (ResponsiveContainer sizing race). Pre-existing, not related to new PH launch section.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) Home ribbon data-testid=ph-launch-ribbon renders at top, CTA (ph-launch-ribbon-cta) href='/login', close (ph-launch-ribbon-close) hides ribbon, localStorage key 'bracket.ph_ribbon_dismissed'='1' persists across reload, clearing key re-shows ribbon. (2) Admin /admin Analytics tab shows all 4 KPI tiles (kpi-ph-claimed=0, kpi-ph-active=0, kpi-ph-converted=0, kpi-ph-conversion=0%) plus 'Launch offer' + 'Product Hunt — first project free' headers; 30 total kpi-* tiles render (existing KPI strip intact, no crash). (3) On /project/222535e8-18f0-403d-b62f-d0048acbbc72 the change-notification-banner appears with title 'Something changed in New Project — SaaS Dashboard Redesign', Review button opens the Project Update review modal ('PROJECT CHANGE' — 'Bracket is gathering the full impact...'), dismiss button hides the banner. Only minor pre-existing console noise (hydration warning on <option><span>, Recharts sizing warnings) unrelated to the new features.
